# Montis brand kit

This folder has everything HeyGen's Brand Kit needs for Montis videos. Upload the files here, and type in the colours and fonts listed below.

## Logo

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `montis-logo-512.png` | Main logo: title and end cards, and the small corner logo |
| `montis-logo-256.png`, `montis-logo-192.png` | Smaller copies of the same logo |

These are the Montis app icons from `public/icons`. Use them as they are, on their light-grey square, without recolouring or cropping.

The name is written **Montis.icu**. "Montis" is white on dark backgrounds or Ink on light ones, and ".icu" is Aqua. Both use Manrope ExtraBold.

Lines already in use: "Endurance data, turned into decisions." and "Adapt · Train · Evolve".

## Colours

| Name | Hex | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Night | `#071310` | Dark backgrounds |
| Deep green | `#0c201b` | Panels and cards on dark |
| Montis green | `#19b77a` | Highlights and buttons |
| Dark green | `#087c58` | Green text on light backgrounds |
| Aqua | `#55d7c0` | Accents, and the ".icu" in the name |
| Paper | `#f4f6f0` | Light backgrounds |
| Ink | `#0b1816` | Text on light backgrounds |

## Intelligence Stack tier colours

These are the colours the Montis App uses for the five tiers. Keep them the same in every video.

| Tier | Colour | Hex |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Training Load | Orange | `#ff6900` |
| 2 Physiology Response | Green | `#00bc7d` |
| 3 Performance Intelligence | Blue | `#2b7fff` |
| 4 Adaptation Progression (ESPE) | Purple | `#8e51ff` |
| 5 Adaptive Decision Engine | Red | `#fb2c36` |

## Fonts

Both are free Google Fonts.

- Titles: [Manrope](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Manrope)
- Body text: [DM Sans](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/DM+Sans)

## Images

- `montis-intelligence-stack-dark.png` and `montis-intelligence-stack-light.png`: the five-tier Montis Intelligence Stack, as shown on www.montis.icu (1024 × 1536).

## Setting up the HeyGen Brand Kit

1. In HeyGen, open **Brand Kit**, create a new kit, and call it **Montis**.
2. Upload `montis-logo-512.png` as the logo.
3. Add the colours: Night, Deep green, Montis green, Aqua, Paper and Ink. Add the five tier colours as well for Montis 101.
4. Set the fonts: Manrope for headings, DM Sans for body text.
5. Upload the two Intelligence Stack images.

HeyGen can also build a kit from www.montis.icu. If you do that, check the result against this page.

The video scripts are in [`docs/heygen/`](../../docs/heygen/).
